messages:
Jordan: Thinking of doing a 'bring-a-board-game' team lunch next Wednesday? Quick turn into drinks after 5pm for whoever can stay. Thoughts? :game_die: :taco:
Emily: Love this — what time for lunch? 12:30 or 1pm?
Sam: 12:30 works for me. I can bring Catan and a small card game.
Sanjeev: I’ll be onsite that day so I can join in-person + drinks. 12:30 preferred.
Lisa: I can bring napkins/plates/utensils. Also happy to pick up a small snack pack.
Jordan: Sweet. Quick check — which day is best: Wed / Thu / Fri? If lots prefer Thu we can shift.
Pollbot: Poll: React with :one: for Wed, :two: for Thu, :three: for Fri. Poll open for 24h.
Emily: :one: for me (Wed).
Sam: :two: but fine with Wed if that's easier.
Sanjeev: :three: for drinks-only preference, but Wed is fine if lunch happens.
Lisa: :one: — Wed is easiest.
Jordan: Looks like Wed is winning so far. Sam — if you end up bringing Catan maybe also pack the smaller box? Table space might be tight.
Sam: Yup I’ll bring smaller box + setup notes.
Jordan: Also putting together a tiny signup sheet for food/games/drinks so we don't double up. Will post link in a bit.
Sam: Can we do a vegetarian option callout? A couple of folks are veg.
Lisa: I’ll grab a veggie tray and chips.
Jordan: Signup: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-games-lunch (please add what you’re bringing)
Emily: Done — I can bring iced tea + plastic cups.
Sanjeev: I’ll swing by the bar afterwards with a few teammates, count me in for drinks.
Jordan: Awesome. I’ll announce in #general tomorrow after poll closes. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
